commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.

90+6' 4 - 2 Goal! Georges Mikautadze displays great vision and sends a pass to Thiago Almada (Lyon), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 4:2.
90+5' The linesman signals a throw-in for Le Havre.
90+1' Here comes a substitution. Ilyes Housni (Le Havre) is brought on as a substitute for Abdoulaye Toure.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' A player from Lyon brings down an opponent and commits a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Le Havre.
86' It's time for a substitution. Jordan Veretout (Lyon) comes on in place of Alexandre Lacazette.
85' The referee is firm and issues Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) a deserved yellow card.
82' 3 - 2 Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) receives a cross from the corner kick and sends a shot towards the goal. His effort finds its way behind the helpless goalkeeper and into the top right corner.
82' Corner kick. Lyon will have an opportunity.
81' Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
78' 2 - 2 Malick Fofana (Lyon) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home inside the left post. The goalkeeper was helpless.
77' Paulo Fonseca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Georges Mikautadze (Lyon) replacing Rayan Cherki.
77' What a wasted opportunity by Rayan Cherki (Lyon)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Mathieu Gorgelin makes a decent save to thwart him.
76' Thiago Almada (Lyon) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mathieu Gorgelin intercepts the ball.
71' The substitution has been made. Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) has replaced Andre Ayew.
71' Substitution. Yassine Kechta walks off the pitch and Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) comes on as a substitute.
71' Here is a change. Issa Soumare is going off and Didier Digard gives the last tactical orders to Ahmed Hassan (Le Havre).
71' Paulo Fonseca has decided to make a change. Malick Fofana (Lyon) replaces Ernest Nuamah.
67' Loic Nego (Le Havre) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
66' Bastien Dechepy interrupts the game. One of the players from Le Havre won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. A free kick to Lyon.
64' Mathieu Gorgelin (Le Havre) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.

63' Thiago Almada (Lyon) in a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes with a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better. His effort ends wide of the right post.
63' Great teamplay by Lyon as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
62' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
58' The ball is out of play. Lyon win a corner kick.
57' Lyon take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
57' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
55' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
54' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
52' The free kick from long range, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

51' Bastien Dechepy interrupts the game. One of the players from Lyon won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. It's a free kick to Le Havre, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
49' One of the Lyon players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
47' Thiago Almada (Lyon) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Paulo Fonseca probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Nemanja Matic. He is replaced by Tanner Tessmann (Lyon).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' Bastien Dechepy has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
45+1' 1 - 2 Fantastic team goal! Josue Casimir (Le Havre) was set free in the area by Issa Soumare and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
45+1' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' It's a throw-in for Le Havre.
42' Dangerous play by Clinton Mata (Lyon). Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
37' Celebrations are cut short for Lyon as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
37' Wait! Referee Bastien Dechepy has indicated he is going to review the Lyon goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
36' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a goal!
35' A player from Le Havre commits a rough challenge. Bastien Dechepy blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Lyon earn a free kick.
31' 1 - 1 Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) sends Lucas Perri the wrong way and fires the penalty into the middle of the goal!
31' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is going to take the penalty!
31' It’s a PENALTY to Le Havre after the VAR review!

28' Play continues despite the shouts by some Le Havre players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Bastien Dechepy interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
28' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Le Havre for a penalty. Play continues.
26' A brilliant cross into the box finds Issa Soumare (Le Havre), who directs his header to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes an astonishing save.
25' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar.
24' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Le Havre.
22' 1 - 0 Goal! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Mathieu Gorgelin into right side of the goal.
22' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
21' The Lyon players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

20' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Lyon.
20' PENALTY APPEAL by Lyon, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
19' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block.
18' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Rayan Cherki (Lyon).
17' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Lucas Perri comes off the line to clear the ball away.
15' 77:23 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
13' Bastien Dechepy blows his whistle as Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
12' Thiago Almada (Lyon) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

11' Thiago Almada (Lyon) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Lyon will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
10' Lyon control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
8' A cross by Josue Casimir (Le Havre) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
7' Thiago Almada (Lyon) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Thiago Almada (Lyon) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar.
5' Junior Mwanga (Le Havre) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
4' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
3' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Issa Soumare (Le Havre), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
3' Nemanja Matic (Lyon) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
